message.content: In the conversation regarding the new software WolfgangSchulz shared with LiHua, he expressed that the project was nearing completion and LiHua was among the first users. WolfgangSchulz emphasized the features and user-friendliness of the software, noting that LiHua would likely enjoy it. LiHua responded positively, expressing excitement about trying out the software and acknowledging the effort WolfgangSchulz had put into its development. She mentioned her eagerness to use it and noted that she was always up for trying new things, especially if they could make her work easier. This indicates that LiHua is enthusiastic about the new software and looks forward to using it.
